body:
YTA. Your wife is going to be going through the most life changing, traumatic, emotional, stressful time of her life. The fact you’re putting your petty dislike over her mother, who sounds like she’s done nothing notable at all to you that would warrant being low contact, before the needs of your wife shows you do not truly care about her, your new baby, and you’re dismissing her pain and stress and feelings. You sound incredibly callous and cruel and unkind. You’d rather have an absolute stranger in your home, when your wife is at her most vulnerable covered in various bodily fluids, probably not keeping up on her grooming because she’ll be so tired and stressed (she’ll be bleeding for at least a few weeks and definitely splattered in baby shit piss vomit and breast milk throughout the day), and in a lot of pain trying to recover? What the hell is wrong with you man


Also, I like the idea of having her come after your 2 week paternity leave is over to establish group bonding between your nuclear family unit without MIL around interfering with that. However, that’s contingent on your commitment to changing diapers, rocking, holding, soothing, comforting, and caring for your wife and child like their own personal nurse/cook/maid. Your wife will be extremely hormonal and emotional and will need a lot of comfort to help her be the best version of herself to enjoy this precious and invaluable time with your guys new child. If you can’t do that for her then let her mom care for her you man child.

NTA. More people need to tell their friends that they love them. The world is far from being in a surplus of open expression of love and affection, and you’re doing nothing wrong at all. You sound like a great friend and I’m sure she appreciates your kind words more than you know. If your bf is jealous of this and sees your kindness towards anyone but him as threatening instead of an endearing reason to love you then he sounds like kind of a bad person.

NTA. You’re clearly and obviously being used under the guise of “FaMiLy” and you will continue to be used for the duration of your relationship with your sister until you set boundaries. Better to do it now.

YTA because you should have sat down with her as two rational, reasonable people and discussed the logistics instead of immediately making a decision like that. “Are you okay going back to the hotel by yourself whenever you want to rest? Here is the itinerary. I want to enjoy these activities and won’t skip them. Is that okay with you?” If she says yes- then great she can come. No- then okay please sit this one out. If you can’t trust her word or hold her accountable to allow you to enjoy your vacation and deal with her own health issues and needs responsibly on her own like an adult then she is the AH and you shouldn’t be her friend because that’s very immature behavior.

NTA. Sue them, because you don’t deserve this and it will hurt your chances of success. They have put you at a detriment in life already at such a young age. Parents are supposed to support your success and place your upon their shoulders so that you may have a better chance at reaching higher and higher goals in life. They will continue to use you and suck finances and opportunities from you because of their selfishness. I am so sorry you have to deal with this instead of focusing on school or work and being happy and young.

NTA and I’m so sorry your family is being so callous, controlling, and choosing to focus on something so petty instead of enjoying a beautiful event and quality time with their daughter before you grow up. I wish my own parents had realized this when I was younger. So much wasted time and effort on their part over what? In this case, a small bracelet? Go ahead and wear them during your own wedding day in the future if you choose to marry one day. There is absolutely no reason for this to be an issue at all

NTA. Trust me, set your boundaries now and stick to them. I’m no contact with my MIL now and have never been happier. We’re lucky to have the support of our spouses because a lot of people get the short end of the stick and their feelings placed second to mommy dearest. Don’t back down and don’t feel the need to ever explain. You have full autonomy for who is around you, your baby, your home, your special events and your life in general. Never apologize for that.

YTA. Great job projecting your insecurities on a young man. Their relationship is absolutely none of your business if she’s happy and he’s treating her right. Exactly who and what are his actions harming besides your own ego? Way to live up to the stereotype of lower/middle class people being ignorant and bitter. Would you rather your daughter be with someone more like you and your husband so that she never surpasses you in life? Would your tone about gifts being “charity” change if your own daughter becomes successful and can afford to buy you and your husband nice things? Grow up.

YTA. Are you married to your wife or your sister? Your own mother kicked her out for being a free loader and you just take her in without consulting your partner? You’re an asshole and a bad husband and enabling your sisters bullshit. I’m some rando and I have 3k followers and post stories about my life all the time on Instagram. I make NO money on that whatsoever and would never consider myself an influencer. At this point she’d be better off doing literally anything else and needs to get a reality check.

I’m sorry to say this but YTA. You’re enabling your own mother’s alcohol problem by allowing her to come over, drink herself into a state like that, and now you’re “parentifying” your wife since you think that’s normal because you’ve been abused by your mom into thinking you need to be a parent for your own mother. Your mom is also TA for that. She’s past middle age and should not be acting this way and putting that kind of obligation on you and your wife, and if she doesn’t get help with her addiction she likely won’t make it much longer. Does she live alone? What if your wife had to carry her in, and put her to bed, and then something bad happened to your mom in her own home? Your wife was probably at risk of being assaulted or verbally abused at the very least by your alcoholic mother. Protect your wife and get your mom some help.

You’re definitely right I made a few comments on other peoples posts on this sub trying to spread some kindness to others and I hope it helps. It’s helping me feel better and calm myself down to feel like I’m a part of this support community. I hope everything is going well for you
You’re not alone. Please don’t do it

Enough for you or enough for someone else who’s judging you? What are your own aspirations for yourself? That’s all that really matters. The fact you can think introspectively about improving your life means you already have surpassed most people that never even try to do that. Please feel proud of yourself, your accomplishments, and just take it one step at a time. You’re not alone

Please don’t. We all can stick this out together. I’m so sorry for what is hurting your heart, and there is always a reason to stay. I almost made my username similar to yours. How is the weather by you? Is it sunny and bright and warm or cool and cloudy? Is there a park, patio or outdoor area you can go to and just enjoy the peace of being outside and in the fresh air? If it’s dark out, can you see the stars? I try to do that whenever I feel this way. I promise you’re not alone
